title: Dispatch authorized ready GitHub Issues through a durable local delivery protocol
acceptance_criteria: Only private allowlisted open autonomous task Issues with independently verified completed dependencies are eligible
Selection is deterministic, source failures stay visible and isolated, and readiness is revalidated before sending
Atomic durable intents permit at most one submit per repository/Issue across processes and restarts; unknown delivery only performs authorized lookup
Trusted file adapters receive bounded identity-only requests through existing cross-platform process lifecycle controls
Dry-run and status perform no writes or backend actions, and dispatcher never mutates GitHub
README and AGENTS explain setup, recovery, limits and continuous authorized backlog execution without claiming a development executor
Independent stage and exact-head PR acceptance, successful three-platform CI and exact-main postmerge acceptance precede automatic Issue14 closure
